purpose: Prevent outcome research from collapsing the original contract into behavior-state tokens. Every original contract domain must be studied when physically available, semantically proven, provenance-linked, and causally known, or explicitly accounted with a non-study reason.

domains.study: prior close/open/high/low/range/path/activity, late-session retention/giveback, completed prior-day context only
previous close versus current open/gap, opening position, open defended/broken, running-low/running-high context
first causal release/initiation, initial displacement, participation change, response efficiency, contradiction
complete TF1M OHLC path from causal point, not only state labels
running/fresh high-low, high/low ordering, time-to-extremes, progression, break/reclaim
pullback depth/path, defense/break, reclaim/non-reclaim, retest and subsequent price response
duration, bar count, spacing, persistence, first-detectable/confirm/fail/recovery timing
volume build/fade/burst/persistence and change relative to price development
trade-value build, acceleration/deceleration, persistence, churn-like activity versus displacement
buy/sell effort versus advance/decline/non-response/resilience and response latency
range expansion/contraction and changing displacement path without inventing canonical volatility fields
how much progress is retained, when giveback starts, recovery/reclaim after giveback
distance already traveled, later room distributions, mature/stale versus developing path; no future value used in live state
observable participation, continuity, gaps/jumps and execution-risk proxies; must not be mislabeled direct order-book liquidity
spread/BBO only if a physically captured, semantically proven source is later bound
depth, imbalance, replenishment/depletion, queue persistence/cancel-replace only if physically captured
net flow direction, magnitude/path, acceleration/deceleration, dominance change, price response/non-response
separate NFSS/provider-equivalent only where exact semantic contract exists; never infer from NBSS
reconstructed magnitude, dominance, changes, lead-lag and response; reconstruction is semantic decomposition, not new raw data
gross buy, gross sell, net, concentration and timing only if physically sourced and semantically proven
aggressor/tick sequence and intensity only if physically captured
only authoritative facts whose publication/known-at time is proven; never backdate period-end information
market/sector regime only if exact contemporaneous source and known-at time are bound
non-confirmation, contradiction, break, failure/invalidation and exact first appearance
reversal, recovery, reclaim and renewed acceleration with exact timing and formation confirmation
MFE/MAE, pre-peak adverse path, high-low ordering, time-to-peak/worst, EOD retention; prohibited as earlier-state input
source/version, exact timestamp/range, first observed/support/change/detectable/known-at/confirm/non-confirm/fail/recovery/end where supported
